## Not exported

Declarations that the exports refer to, without exporting them.

```ts
type ArrayOf<T extends Schema> = T extends z.core.$ZodArray
  ? z.ZodPipe<z.ZodTransform<unknown, unknown>, T>
  : z.ZodPipe<z.ZodTransform<unknown, unknown>, z.ZodArray<T>>

interface BaseResult {
  readonly [RESPONSE_RESULT_BRAND]: true
  readonly init: ResultInit
}

declare const HTTP_ERROR_BRAND: unique symbol

type NativeOf<TAdapter> =
  TAdapter extends HttpAdapter<infer TNative> ? TNative : unknown

type ParamNames<P extends string> = P extends `${string}:${infer Rest}`
  ? Rest extends `${infer Param}/${infer Tail}`
    ? Param | ParamNames<`/${Tail}`>
    : Rest
  : never

declare const RESPONSE_RESULT_BRAND: unique symbol

type Simplify<T> = {
  [K in keyof T]: T[K]
} & {}

type UnionToIntersection<U> = (
  U extends unknown ? (value: U) => void : never
) extends (value: infer I) => void
  ? I
  : never
```
